verification_policy: Single-skill research: reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, costs, mechanics, and taxonomy. Preserve unsupported fields as null.
research_scope: Super Afterimage — Other Super / Counter Skills research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Super Afterimage was found. Canonical identity is Super / Other; Counter Skills membership is retained as a cross-taxonomy characteristic.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Super Afterimage as an Other Super and also lists it in Counter Skills.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Super Afterimage is obtainable by the Future Warrior through the Conton City Skill Shop. It can also be added to many custom partner skillsets after the relevant customization update.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented Future Warrior acquisition route is the Skill Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed canonical sources do not establish a reliable stamina value.

records.name: Super Afterimage
records.character_source: Goku, Bardock, and numerous customizable partners
records.skill_description: Creates multiple afterimages that allow the user to evade attacks or move behind a nearby opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes six afterimages. The user can move during the afterimage sequence and can slip behind a nearby opponent. It is categorized as an Other Super while also being listed under Counter Skills.
records.acquisition_notes: The Future Warrior can purchase Super Afterimage from the Conton City Skill Shop. Partner customization can subsequently make it available to additional character presets.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Its defensive/vanish behavior is documented, including use as a counter-like movement option. Exact frame data and matchup-specific behavior are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
